notes: Every original requirement ID must appear exactly once. The model-facing contract no longer asks for a second overall decision or patch.
Legacy duplicate wrappers are compared by actual object/material/shot identity and leaf values. Extra targets, unexplained fields, conflicting values and protection violations cannot be discarded.
Protocol, material, target and photography corrections share at most two model calls; no paid request or automatic model upgrade was performed. GPT-5.5 remains blocked.

Red/gloss checks only run on already-grounded assignments. Missing roughness uses existing presets; present conflicting values require correction, and explicit user numbers and protections remain authoritative.

The exact screenshot sentence was tested through the real planner and project store with controlled AI fixtures, including mixed ready/pending and already-satisfied cases, correction, replay, source mutation and failure without changes.
Known uncommitted protocol errors return HTTP 422 and a new explicit retry. Unknown network outcomes retain the original request identity; saved operations retry only preview.
Diagnostic exports retain at most ten sanitized records of at most 32 KiB each. Raw model values, images, credentials, arbitrary directory files and symlinks are excluded from these records.
Actual user cabinet geometry and live model recognition success are not verified. Existing synthetic Blender evidence is documented separately in SCENE_PARTS_VERIFICATION.json.
Two original missing-fixture errors remain errors and are not counted as passes.
